# Kanpai Souk Al Bahar

> Kanpai is a Japanese restaurant and lounge on Level 3 of Souk Al Bahar in Downtown Dubai, looking towards the Dubai Fountain and the Burj Khalifa. The dining and retail souk opened in 2008 in Arabesque style and holds more than 100 shops alongside around 22 restaurants and cafés, with a footbridge linking it to The Dubai Mall. Its menu runs from sushi to dishes drawn from across South-East Asia.

## Project Overview

- Category: Residential / Commercial
- Location: Downtown Dubai, UAE
- Status: Completed

## MENASCO Scope

Kanpai is a Japanese restaurant in Downtown Dubai, a short walk from The Dubai Mall, Burj Khalifa and the Dubai Fountain. MENASCO prepared the design drawings for the restaurant, working on behalf of the interior contractor to provide the technical documentation for its fit-out. The commission is one of several Downtown Dubai food and beverage projects for which MENASCO has provided design support.
